prompt: Add a new invoice model type to this package, following best practice.
setup: The package consistently uses interface declarations in PascalCase-named files.
An ESLint configuration enforces consistent-type-definitions as interface.
expected: The new declaration follows the local convention: interface, matching file naming.
The divergence from the skill's type-alias default is at most noted as an observation, not applied.
The lint configuration is treated as the authoritative expression of local style.
must_not: Introduce a type alias that fights the lint rule or disable the rule.
Mix both declaration styles in one diff.
